exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis based on IADPSG criteria
Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis based on WHO criteria
Untreated pregnant women with GDM according to the IADPSG criteria
cohort: 2,405 pregnant women who delivered between January 2009 and December 2010
finding: The IADPSG criteria identified a significantly higher prevalence of GDM compared to the WHO criteria, and pregnant women diagnosed with GDM by the IADPSG criteria, but not the WHO criteria, experienced adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found that women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) had a higher rate of cesarean section compared to the control group.
